instructions.original_snippets: Target 1200-1500 tokens MAX; Session section 780 tokens max.
NEVER overwrite an existing context file without reading it first.
If status is done or parked, move the file to .context/session/done/; never the default stream.
NEVER save at the very start of a session; save at meaningful checkpoints.
Stream naming: default is CONTEXT-llm.md, {name} is CONTEXT-{name}-llm.md.
Use the heading Next, not todo or pending, so compaction keeps it.
NEVER skip the INDEX.md upsert via scripts/upsert-index.sh.
After EVERY AskUserQuestion call, check for empty answers and fall back to a numbered list.
Hot Files: max 10 with brief roles.
When another person picks the work up, use handover-document-creator, not a checkpoint.
